tasks.title: Site 1. Istanbul Heights
tasks.statement: Site 1 is right across the road from an unfinished building of a hotel. Analyze the map extract and assuming that each floor of this building is 2.5 meters in height and the terrace on its roof is the same height, answer the questions from the next slide.

parts.question: Is the absolute height (elevation) of the hotel building higher than pillars of bridges over The Bosphorus strait?
Estimate the difference (in meters) of the height of this building and the pillars of the highest bridge over The Bosphorus.

tasks.title: Site 2 – Mediterranean Vegetation
tasks.statement: Site 2 is in the middle of the Ataturk urban forest, established in 2021. This is a park with native and planted trees, developed on the unbuilt area in Sariyer district. Be an expert in Mediterranean vegetation and answer the questions 2.A. and 2.B.

parts.question: The Mediterranean forests, woodlands and shrubs biome is spread worldwide. Provide the common names of five different Mediterranean types of vegetation and specify the continents where each of these types is represented.
Select the species from the photos which are NOT native for the forests of modern Istanbul city area and write down on the Response Sheet the corresponding letter codes (A-F).

tasks.title: Site 3 – Geology of Eastern Thrace
tasks.statement: Site 3 is near a rock outcrop.

parts.question: Identify the exposed rock and its origin.
The chronostratigraphic chart below contains the results from drilling a geological borehole here. Which geological system (period) name is omitted in Column 1?
Match the rocks, shown on figures 3.A.-3.F., to the layers 2-6 in the Chronostratigraphic chart.
Identify the rock from the Figure 3 NOT found in this borehole and give their origin.

tasks.title: Site 4 – River
tasks.statement: Site 4 is located on the dam over a small river running through the Ataturk urban forest. Consult the map extract and circle on the printed map the catchment area of this river.

parts.question: Estimate the annual runoff of this river (m3).

In urban households equipped with water pipe and sanitation systems, the water consumption norm per capita is 150 liters. How many people could hypothetically get all the water they need from this river? (provide a number)
Why in real life, is this number much lower, and what are the options for make it closer to the hypothetic number?

tasks.title: Site 5 – Building on Slopes
tasks.statement: Site 5 corresponds to the spot marked with ‘X’ on the map extract in the Response Sheet.

parts.question: Mark Spot ‘Y’ on this fragment, which is located 40 meters from Spot X on a bearing of 60 degrees (in azimuth 60 degrees).
Estimate the steepness of the slope (inclination angle in degrees) between spots X and Y.

Which types of mass wasting (slope movement) represent danger for building on slopes with similar steepness near the Ataturk Urban Forest: a) avalanche, b) creep, c) lahar, d) landslide, e) rock-fall, f) solifluction?

tasks.title: Concluding Question
tasks.statement: Near the Ataturk urban forest several traditional rural style houses can be found. Until 1937, there was a settlement here, named Çamlıtepe Village.

parts.question: Which features of this geographical location have benefited the development of this settlement?
